page.layout: One printed page: a running head at the top, a page number at the top right, a full-page engraving of a shell-like figure in the upper and middle part, and a gathering signature and catchword at the foot. The faint lines of text below the figure are show-through from the other side of the leaf and are not transcribed.
page.notes: The upper and middle part of the page holds a large engraving of a shell-like or fossil figure with hatched edges; it is an illustration, not text. Faint grey lines of text and a faint ghost of another engraving in the lower half are show-through from the reverse side and were left out. The running head and page number are read from the top of the page; the page number reads as "161". The catchword "Hic" and signature "L" are printed in bold type at the foot of the page.
